source.note: A line of `%%` alone between the frontmatter and the flowchart header: the specification reads it as a diagram comment with the mark %%, and mermaid.js, whose flowchart lexer does not read it so, rejects the input.

error.name: Error
error.message:
Parse error on line 1:
%%flowchart LRA-->
^
Expecting 'NEWLINE', 'SPACE', 'GRAPH', got 'NODE_STRING'
